description: FICTIONAL Galaxy-class (TNG) survey itinerary: Starbase 1 -> Farpoint Station -> Deep Space 9 -> Risa -> Starbase 74 -> Starbase 1, over the fictional federation port library (docs/variant_surveillance_spec.md §3). Ports, dates, and ashore windows are invented for the setting, not literature-anchored. Longer and higher-liberty than the Constitution patrol (families aboard), so it gives a different port-call sequence and a larger ashore-hours denominator. effects_enabled=false and shore_exposure.enabled=false, so the itinerary is analysis-only metadata and campaigns stay identical to the pre-itinerary baseline. platform_class is omitted: the schema enum covers cruise classes only, and a starship class is not one of them.

itinerary.notes: Homeport. Crew and civilian families board.
Frontier construction site: limited port programme, so a shore introduction here is largely invisible ashore.
Wormhole chokepoint: heavy mixing on the Promenade, and the one call with arrival screening in both directions.
Largest catchment and highest liberty of either itinerary against a minimal port programme: the dominant exposure term.
Yard call: dense port surveillance, so this is where a ship-inferred hazard can be checked against an independent signal.
